-- CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgstattuple;
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS table_name, i.relname AS index_name, pg_size_pretty(s.index_size) AS total_size, round(s.avg_leaf_density::numeric, 2) AS density_pct, -- Cálculo de páginas "mortas" (vazias + eliminadas) (s.empty_pages + s.deleted_pages) AS dead_pages, -- Estimativa de espaço recuperável (em bytes, mas formatado) pg_size_pretty( ( (s.empty_pages + s.deleted_pages)::numeric * current_setting('block_size')::numeric + (s.leaf_pages::numeric * (100 - s.avg_leaf_density)::numeric / 100 * current_setting('block_size')::numeric) )::numeric ) AS estimated_recoverable_space, CASE WHEN ( ((s.empty_pages + s.deleted_pages)::numeric * current_setting('block_size')::numeric + (s.leaf_pages::numeric * (100 - s.avg_leaf_density)::numeric / 100 * current_setting('block_size')::numeric)) > 1073741824 -- 1GB em bytes AND s.avg_leaf_density < 60 ) THEN '⚠️ Attention' ELSE NULL END AS status_alert FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL pgstatindex(i.oid) s WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND c.relkind = 'r' AND i.relam = 403 -- B-Tree AND x.indisvalid ORDER BY s.index_size DESC;
